title: Raya and the Last Dragon
tagline: Every land adds to the bowl.
about: A warrior princess searches for the last dragon to bring the divided lands of Kumandra back together.
cue: Serve the mains when Benja plans a meal to share with the five lands.

Toss with the garlic, red chillies and lime zest.Mix the fish sauce, lime juice and sugar for the dipping sauce.Thread the prawns onto skewers.Grill in batches, turning once, until pink.Serve from the boat with the dipping sauce.Talon night market spring rollsPrawns, vermicelli and herbs in rice paper, with a peanut hoisin dipHow to make it12 rice paper sheets300g cooked prawns100g rice vermicelli1/2 cup mint leaves1/2 cup coriander leaves6 lettuce leaves3 tbsp peanut butter2 tbsp hoisin sauceSoak the vermicelli in boiling water until soft, then drain.Prepare the prawns, mint leaves, coriander leaves and lettuce.Warm the peanut butter with the hoisin and a splash of water for a thick dipping sauce.Soak the rice paper sheets one at a time, fill with prawns, vermicelli, herbs and lettuce and roll tightly.Ongi pandan coconut rice cakesBouncy steamed bites of glutinous flour and pandan, salted cream on top, cheeky as Noi's gangHow to make itNot on tonight's cookBouncy little steamed cakes of rice flour, coconut milk and pandan, topped with salty coconut cream and toasted coconut, mischievous as Noi's Ongis.Whisk 150g glutinous rice flour, 50g rice flour, 100g caster sugar, 300ml coconut milk and 1 tsp pandan paste until smooth.Pour into 16 small greased cups and steam over boiling water for 15 minutes until set.Cool 20 minutes and turn out.Warm 100ml coconut cream with a pinch of salt and spoon a little over each, then scatter with toasted shredded coconut.Green papaya saladBring extra, the ongis have nine stomachs.How to make itA house standard, not part ginger (4cm), sliced400g green prawns, peeled1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained1 red chilli, sliced1/2 tsp caster sugarBruise the lemongrass and slice the ginger.Simmer the rice in the stock with the lemongrass and ginger, stirring often, until creamy.Peel the prawns.Add the prawns and bamboo shoots for the last few minutes.Top with chilli and a pinch of sugar.Kumandra five lands beef noodle paper-thin raw beef, piled with herbs, bean sprouts, chilli, lime and hoisin.Char 1 halved onion and a 5cm piece of ginger in a dry pan.Simmer with 2L beef stock, 3 star anise, 1 cinnamon stick, 2 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp sugar for 30 minutes, then strain.Freeze 300g sirloin for 30 minutes and slice paper thin.Soak 400g rice noodles and divide between bowls.Top with raw beef and pour over the
